+"""Generate a replayable trajectory for the frozen utensils-in-mug instance."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from scipy.spatial import ConvexHull
+
+from rcb_robolab import Session
+
+
+OUT = Path("/app/output")
+TRAJ = OUT / "trajectory.npz"
+
+
+def quat_rotate(q, v):
+    """Rotate vector(s) by a WXYZ quaternion."""
+    q = np.asarray(q, dtype=float)
+    v = np.asarray(v, dtype=float)
+    qv = q[1:]
+    return v + 2.0 * np.cross(qv, np.cross(qv, v) + q[0] * v)
+
+
+def hull_centroid_world(session, prim, name):
+    points = np.asarray(prim["get_object_points"](name), dtype=float)
+    hull = ConvexHull(points)
+    return points[hull.vertices].mean(axis=0)
+
+
+def projected_long_axis(points):
+    xy = np.asarray(points, dtype=float)[:, :2]
+    xy = xy - xy.mean(axis=0)
+    vals, vecs = np.linalg.eigh(xy.T @ xy / max(1, len(xy)))
+    return vecs[:, int(np.argmax(vals))]
+
+
+def move_one(session, prim, name, mug_xy, table_top):
+    points = np.asarray(prim["get_object_points"](name), dtype=float)
+    center = hull_centroid_world(session, prim, name)
+    long_axis = projected_long_axis(points)
+    close_dir = np.array([-long_axis[1], long_axis[0]])
+    yaw = float(prim["yaw_for_closing_dir"](close_dir))
+    quat = prim["top_down_quat"](yaw)
+
+    print(f"{name}: mesh centroid={np.round(center, 4).tolist()}, long_axis={np.round(long_axis, 3).tolist()}, yaw={yaw:.3f}", flush=True)
+    prim["open_gripper"](steps=15)
+    prim["move_ee"]([center[0], center[1], 0.205], quat, speed=0.22, settle=3)
+    # The TCP is at the closed fingertip ends; lowering close to the tabletop puts
+    # the 5.7 cm finger pads over the utensils while keeping the wrist clear.
+    prim["move_ee"]([center[0], center[1], table_top + 0.007], quat, speed=0.08, max_dq=0.045, settle=3)
+    prim["close_gripper"](steps=22)
+    prim["move_ee"]([center[0], center[1], 0.205], quat, speed=0.12, max_dq=0.055, settle=8)
+
+    # Move above the mug first. Read the carried object's current rigid transform
+    # so the final command centers its convex-hull centroid, including any local
+    # mesh offset from the rigid-body origin, over the opening.
+    prim["move_ee"]([mug_xy[0], mug_xy[1], 0.205], quat, speed=0.20, max_dq=0.06, settle=5)
+    obj_pos, obj_q = session.object_pose(name)
+    obj_centroid = hull_centroid_world(session, prim, name)
+    ee_pos, ee_q = session.ee_pose()
+    offset = obj_centroid - ee_pos
+    place_centroid = np.array([mug_xy[0], mug_xy[1], 0.103])
+    place_ee = place_centroid - offset
+    print(f"{name}: carried root={np.round(obj_pos,4).tolist()}, centroid={np.round(obj_centroid,4).tolist()}, ee={np.round(ee_pos,4).tolist()}, place_ee={np.round(place_ee,4).tolist()}", flush=True)
+    prim["move_ee"](place_ee, quat, speed=0.10, max_dq=0.04, settle=4)
+    prim["open_gripper"](steps=18)
+    prim["hold"](steps=25)
+    print(f"{name}: after release root={np.round(session.object_pose(name)[0],4).tolist()} status={session.status()}", flush=True)
+    # Clear the rim before moving to the other utensil.
+    prim["move_ee"]([mug_xy[0], mug_xy[1], 0.25], quat, speed=0.15, max_dq=0.06)
+
+
+def main():
+    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    s = Session("utensils_in_mug", instance="/app/instance.json")
+    p = s.primitives()
+    obj = s.objects()
+    table_top = float(obj["table"]["bounds"][1][2])
+    mug_xy = np.asarray(obj["ceramic_mug"]["position"][:2], dtype=float)
+    print("Initial state", json.dumps(s.status()), "ee", s.ee_pose()[0].round(4).tolist(), flush=True)
+
+    s.record_start()
+    try:
+        move_one(s, p, "fork_big", mug_xy, table_top)
+        if not s.episode_done:
+            move_one(s, p, "spoon_big", mug_xy, table_top)
+    except Exception as e:
+        print("Trajectory generation stopped:", type(e).__name__, str(e), flush=True)
+        raise
+    finally:
+        actions = s.record_stop()
+        s.save_trajectory(actions, TRAJ, meta={"generator": "gen.py", "objects": ["fork_big", "spoon_big"]})
+        print("Saved", TRAJ, "actions", actions.shape, "status", s.status(), flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
